ms.promise:
We will migrate our private repositories into public open source MIT repositories under the Charli3 organization. Codebases will be restructured, licensed under MIT, and prepared with READMEs, contribution guidelines, and a roadmap outline to support future community collaboration.
Additionally, we will provide a short video to use the repos and documentation.

・Contribution guidelines
